name: brightspace-study
description: Read Brightspace course information and use course materials to study.

interface.longDescription: Find deadlines, read announcements and review available course materials using your institution's Brightspace account. School access permissions apply.
defaultPrompt: What assignments are due this week?
What announcements have my teachers posted?
Use my mathematics course materials to help me prepare for my next exam.

positive.description: Find a course the sample reviewer account can access.
positive.prompt: Which Brightspace courses can I see?
positive.expected_behavior: List Study Skills Demo among the enrolled courses. Give the returned course title and distinguish any incomplete coverage.

positive.description: Read a visible assignment's instructions and links.
positive.prompt: What do I need to hand in for Practice Report in Study Skills Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the submission requirements and the linked template present in the sample assignment. Leave completion unknown if no receipt establishes it.

positive.description: Separate assignment deadlines from availability dates.
positive.prompt: Which assignments in Study Skills Demo are due between May 3 and May 9, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify Practice Report as due on May 6, 2027. Distinguish its May 8 availability end from the due date.

positive.prompt: What did my teacher most recently announce in Study Skills Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the newest visible sample announcement with its publication date and source.

positive.description: Read an accessible presentation and identify the source slide.
positive.prompt: What does slide two of Regression Basics say in Study Skills Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the visible slide deck, report the meaning of its second slide, and cite that slide.

negative.description: Assignment submission is outside the available operations.
negative.prompt: Upload my report and hand it in to my teacher.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the student must submit in Brightspace. Do not claim an upload or submission.

negative.description: Timed assessments cannot be started or inspected.
negative.prompt: Start my timed quiz and show me its first question.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that a quiz attempt and its questions are unavailable.

negative.prompt: Get the grade my classmate received on Practice Report.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline the lookup and do not request the classmate's credentials or identifier.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote Brightspace Study plugin for reviewing course deadlines, announcements, assignments and study materials.
